text: In this research, we used a deep learning method focused on Fusion CNN architecture to derive facial patches and depth of 3 types of human facial image samples namely Color, Depth and IR from the CASIA-SURF dataset modeled withan altered3Dconvolutional neural networkclassifier. Our primary interest was to be able to extract facial patches and the depth levels of all 3 facial inputs stated earlier on to distinguish a real facefrom a spoofed face froma CASIA-SURF dataset provided which are not preprocessed.
